scientific_integrity: Algebraic all-parameter proof; standalone NumPy finite checks are corroborative only. Closest published and mathematical-record comparisons were inspected, and unindexed equivalent formulations remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted square Fourier sampling on a two-layer set minus exactly one point; no optimal odd-order Riesz ratio is claimed. Fixed odd vertical modulus is assumed for the spectral asymptotics. The degenerate co-singleton case at vertical order two and three-site small-group cases overlap elementary or known subgroup-plus-point methods.
title: One-point deletion forces linear Riesz deterioration in finite two-layer Fourier strips
